Map of expanded build configuration names to their JSON source names.

## Signature

```typescript
protected readonly _jsonBuildConfigurationsNamesMap: Map<string, string>;
```

## Remarks

This reverse mapping enables retrieving the original configuration definition from `jsonBuildConfigurations` when lazy-loading configuration instances.

Mapping behavior:

1. For regular configurations: Maps configuration name to itself (identity mapping).

2. For template configurations: Maps each generated configuration name back to the original template name (e.g., `release-x64` → `release-{{ matrix.arch }}`<!-- -->).

3. Known only after [XpmLiquidBuildConfigurations.initialise()](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/xpmliquidbuildconfigurations/initialise) completes.

4. Enables [XpmLiquidBuildConfigurations.get()](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/xpmliquidbuildconfigurations/get) to locate the correct JSON definition when instantiating a configuration on demand.

This indirection is essential for lazy evaluation, allowing deferred instantiation while maintaining the connection to original definitions.
